description:
**Summary (5 lines):**

1. Task: make the **Messages** section of the solopreneur screen open the already-existing **Messenger** (`src/views/MessengerView.vue`) instead of the mock chat thread it had inline.
2. `SolopreneurMessages.vue` was rewritten as a thin, full-height **host** for `MessengerView`, mapping its `account-settings` event to `goModule('account')` — no duplicated chat code.
3. `src/views/SolopreneurView.vue` gained a `FILL_MODULES = ['messages']` layout tier so that module gets an `overflow-hidden`, padding-free `<main>`, while all other modules keep the padded scrolling card column.
4. The old mock state in `useSolopreneur.js` (seeded `messages`, `sendMessage`, `pickReply`, `ui.typing` and its `ms.*` i18n keys) became dead code; removing it was flagged as optional and still pending your approval.
5. `SolopreneurSidebar`, `SolopreneurModal` and the router/app config needed no changes, since the `messages` module id was kept as-is.

messages.content: The Messages section in solopreneur will open the "Messenger". Use the existing components
